sloka: सीताया वचनम् श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् ।हस्ते हस्तम् समाहत्य चकार सुमहत् वपुः ॥३-४९-१॥
transliteration: sītāyā vacanam śrutvā daśagrīvaḥ pratāpavān ।haste hastam samāhatya cakāra sumahat vapuḥ ॥3-49-1॥

translations.english: On hearing the Sita's words, the powerful Ravana struck his palms one over the other and assumed a huge form (original figure).
